mapper.select: SELECT id, warehouse_id, material_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM t_stock_balance WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND material_id = #{materialId}

SELECT sb.id, sb.warehouse_id, sb.material_id, sb.quantity, sb.created_at, sb.updated_at, m.name as materialName, m.spec as materialSpec, m.unit as materialUnit FROM t_stock_balance sb INNER JOIN t_material m ON sb.material_id = m.id WHERE sb.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sb.quantity > 0
SELECT id, warehouse_id, material_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM t_stock_balance WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND quantity > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_stock_balance (warehouse_id, material_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{materialId}, #{delta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW()
